question: Can simultaneous Hurwitz-space dimension for the degree-105 and degree-81 maps D->C2, together with the retained common-V4 pullback condition, exclude any of the 29 h=4 states?

ex1_05g.exact_use: D is smooth, the pair map phi=(f105,f81):D->C2xC2 is birational onto Gamma, deg(f105)=105, deg(f81)=81, g(D)=106+r, R105=2r, R81=48+2r, and f105^*Z is isomorphic to f81^*Z as the retained relative H-torsor.

ex1_05h.exact_use: Ramification totals R105=2r and R81=48+2r are retained for all r=0..28; branch support is not extracted.

parent_05m.exact_use: The plain two-projection genus bound is already dominated/nonpruning; 05N tests deformation dimension rather than genus size.

external_stable_map_deformation.author: Rahul Pandharipande (lecture notes; notes taken by Dhyan Aranha)
external_stable_map_deformation.title: Moduli Spaces of Stable Maps and GW Theory, I
external_stable_map_deformation.exact_use: For maps to a smooth projective target, deformation/obstruction theory gives the stable-map virtual dimension (dim X-3)(1-g)+c1(TX).beta for n=0; actual dimension need not equal virtual dimension when obstruction is present.

pair_map_setup.reason_generically_immersive: Over C a nonconstant birational map from a smooth curve to its integral image has nonzero differential generically; hence T_D -> phi^*T_X is injective as a sheaf.

common_ramification_torsion.definition: tau=length Tor(N_phi)=deg gcd(R105,R81), coefficientwise on D
common_ramification_torsion.local_replay: At a local parameter t, dphi is generated by (u'(t),v'(t)) in O^2. Smith normal form over the DVR gives torsion length min(ord u',ord v'), hence the global torsion divisor is gcd(R105,R81).
common_ramification_torsion.interpretation: The negative simultaneous expected dimension is absorbed by a large obstruction space. Branch overlap controls only the tangent dimension, not existence.

same_target_negative_virtual_dimension_c.semantic_use: Even on the identical genus-2 product target, a genuine map can exist with negative virtual dimension; therefore negativity alone is not a nonexistence theorem.

common_v4_dimension_firewall.retained_condition: f105^*Z ~= f81^*Z for the finite etale H=(Z/2)^2 cover Z->C2, equivalently the retained mod-2 fixed-plane condition after push-pull.
common_v4_dimension_firewall.rule: Do not subtract an additional Hurwitz-space dimension for the common-V4 condition without a source-bound infinitesimal or branch-cycle codimension theorem.

decision.reason: For every r, the pair-map virtual dimension is negative, but the exact normal-sheaf calculation shows a nonzero obstruction space of dimension at least 267-r. Negative virtual dimension therefore supplies no emptiness statement. The retained common-V4 condition currently has no source-bound continuous codimension or branch-cycle incompatibility that could turn this into an exclusion.
decision.reopen_condition: Produce a source-bound obstruction calculation proving the actual obstruction class cannot vanish for the fixed-V6 pair map, or a common-V4 branch-cycle/monodromy theorem incompatible with the simultaneous ramification data.

breadth_audit.trigger: 05N exposes a new exact deformation-obstruction invariant and the active route would otherwise narrow toward a theorem gate; run an early EXHAUSTIVE_VIEW_AUDIT under the cycle protocol.

generated_views.reason: Use the actual equality of pulled-back etale H-torsors at the level of fundamental-group/branch-cycle monodromy, rather than charging an unsupported continuous dimension.

05H gives R81-R105 linearly equivalent to f105^*K_C2-f81^*K_C2 and hence a 2-divisible class; a spin/theta parity invariant might distinguish realizable branch data, but no exact adapter is yet source-locked.

Move from the Rosati norm shell to effectivity/integrality of the actual correspondence divisor class on C2xC2. This is distinct from the plain CS and Hurwitz dimension routes but may require a larger finite End(J) computation.
Directly materialize or disprove a V6 section/member; preserve this candidate but avoid duplicating the dedicated EX2 reconstruction lane without an import adapter.

next_route.selection_reason: 05N proves that continuous dimension counting is obstruction-dominated. The closest materially distinct receiver is therefore the discrete branch-cycle realization problem for the same two covers under the exact isomorphism f105^*Z ~= f81^*Z. This can potentially exclude states without needing unsupported transversality.
